summaryLines: UX review: 5 major, 259 minor across 93 screens. Weakest: Frustration and abandonment risk 0.9/5, Appropriateness 2.1/5, Design consistency 4.5/5.
First value 37.8 s, relaunch 10.3 s, 0 gate taps. Taps: find the best rate 0, compare unknown, open a lender unknown, open a product 1, save a rate unknown.
Frustration and abandonment risk 0.9/5: 5 major, 134 minor.
- major | restart with a saved rate: slow, 18.3 s to settle | Fix: Show content first and defer the slow work
- major | leave removed product: spinner-no-result "screen never settled", screen kept changing until the settle timeout | Fix: Replace the spinner with a result or a retry action
- major | leave removed product: slow, 20.2 s to settle | Fix: Show content first and defer the slow work
- major | cold start: slow-first-value, 37.8 s from launch to rates showing | Fix: Show cached rates on launch before the refresh
- major | cold start: slow-relaunch, 10.3 s from relaunch to rates showing | Fix: Draw the cached rates first, then refresh in the background
- minor | open app: jargon "Cairns · CLASSIC HOME LOAN VARIABLE 60-80 LVR PI", unexpanded LVR | Fix: Replace the abbreviation with a plain label
